name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Moves through pages of results with page numbers, previous/next and a page-size choice.

when: A list or table with more results than fit one page.

instead.when: The rows already live in a table with paging built in.
A single Load more continues a feed.

builtIn: The current page is marked; the range is announced ("41–60 of 1,204").

genui.description: Page controls for a long list. page is 1-based. Emits change.
